name: Atari 800
credits: Layout after the Atari 800 (1979) keyboard; colours after its beige-brown case, dark brown caps and orange-brown console keys.
notes: Faithful: the same key matrix as the Atari 400, now as the 800's full-travel sculpted keys: dark brown caps with white upper-case legends on the beige-brown case, BREAK at the end of the number row, CAPS/LOWR beside *, the inverse-video key after the right SHIFT, the shifted, CLEAR, INSERT, DELETE and cursor-arrow legends above the characters, and SYSTEM RESET (RESET under SYSTEM, as on the cap), OPTION, SELECT and START as the orange-brown column on the right. Letters type lower case and SHIFT upper case; LOWR locks capitals here. Approximated: widths are compressed to fit a phone, there is no gap before the console keys, the inverse key is the text ◪ with ATARI above (no logo), and shifted < and > type < and >. Mapped to none: BREAK, TAB, CTRL, the inverse key and the console keys. The cursor arrows on - = + * were CTRL combinations and are out of scope.
